description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Braum's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] and ''[[File:Braum Winter's Bite.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Winter's Bite|An icon for Braum's ability Winter's Bite]] [[Braum#Winter's Bite|Winter's Bite]]'' each apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Concussive Blows'' to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times. Once the first stack has been applied, any allied [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion's]] basic attack applies an additional stack to the target [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]].
description.text: Innate: Braum's basic attacks and Winter's Bite each apply a stack of Concussive Blows to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times. Once the first stack has been applied, any allied champion's basic attack applies an additional stack to the target on-hit.

description2.raw: The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to deal 26 – 196 (based on his level) magic damage and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] them for 1.25 – 1.75 (based on his level) seconds.
description2.text: The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to deal 26 – 196 (based on his level) magic damage and stun them for 1.25 – 1.75 (based on his level) seconds.

description3.raw: This effect cannot apply to the same target more than once every few seconds. During this immunity period, affected targets take「 '''bonus''' magic damage equal to 40% of the trigger damage 」「 10.4 – 78.4 (based on level) '''bonus''' magic damage 」from '''Braum's''' basic attacks.
description3.text: This effect cannot apply to the same target more than once every few seconds. During this immunity period, affected targets take「 bonus magic damage equal to 40% of the trigger damage 」「 10.4 – 78.4 (based on level) bonus magic damage 」from Braum's basic attacks.

notes.raw: * ''Concussive Blows'' won't be applied if the attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] or if the attack [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|misses]].
notes.text: Concussive Blows won't be applied if the attack is dodged or blocked or if the attack misses.
